```{python}
#| tags: [parameters]
sat_name = "SO-50"
rise_iso = "2026-10-17T13:00:00+00:00"
peak_iso = "2026-10-17T13:04:00+00:00"
set_iso = "2026-10-17T13:09:00+00:00"
max_el = 60.0
az_r = 220.0
az_s = 26.0
lat = 39.76
lon = -84.19
elev = 225.0
tz_name = "America/New_York"
beamwidth_deg = 74.0  # Elk 2M/440L5: 8.7 dBi at 2 m -> sqrt(41253/7.4) ~ 74 deg (estimate)
```

```{python}
#| label: compute
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

ROOT = Path.cwd().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from skyfield.api import load, wgs84
import sat_cue_sheets as scs

tz = ZoneInfo(tz_name)
rise = datetime.fromisoformat(rise_iso)
peak = datetime.fromisoformat(peak_iso)
setting = datetime.fromisoformat(set_iso)
info = scs.SATS[sat_name]

ts = load.timescale()
sat = scs.load_sat(info["norad"], ts)
site = wgs84.latlon(lat, lon, elev)
rows = scs.sat_ladder(sat, site, ts, ts.from_datetime(rise), ts.from_datetime(setting),
                      info["up"], info["down"])
STEP_S = scs.STEP_S
```

#set page(numbering: none)

```

## `{python} sat_name` Pass Plan {.unnumbered}

**`{python} f"{rise.astimezone(tz):%A %m/%d/%Y}"`**
\ \ \ \ Rise `{python} f"{rise.astimezone(tz):%H:%M:%S}"`
\ \ Max `{python} f"{peak.astimezone(tz):%H:%M:%S}"`
\ \ Set `{python} f"{setting.astimezone(tz):%H:%M:%S}"`
\ \ \ \ Max El `{python} f"{max_el:.0f}"`°
\ \ \ \ Az `{python} f"{az_r:.0f}"`°→`{python} f"{az_s:.0f}"`°

**TX (uplink) `{python} f"{info['up']:.3f}"` MHz FM, `{python} info["tone"]`**
\ \ \ \ **RX (downlink) `{python} f"{info['down']:.3f}"` MHz FM** — Doppler-corrected, rounded to 5 kHz (error up to 2.5 kHz)

```{python}
#| label: skyplot
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from datetime import timedelta

# Dense track for the line, ladder rows for the labelled time ticks.
secs = np.arange(0, (setting - rise).total_seconds() + 1, 5)
track = []
for sdt in secs:
    t = ts.from_datetime(rise + timedelta(seconds=float(sdt)))
    alt, az, _ = (sat - site).at(t).altaz()
    if alt.degrees >= 0:
        track.append((az.degrees, alt.degrees))
track = np.array(track)

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(4.4, 4.4))
ax = fig.add_subplot(projection="polar")
ax.set_theta_zero_location("N")
ax.set_theta_direction(-1)
ax.set_rlim(90, 0)
ax.set_rticks([0, 30, 60])
ax.set_yticklabels(["", "60°", "30°"], fontsize=7, color="gray")
ax.set_rlabel_position(135)
ax.set_xticks(np.radians(np.arange(0, 360, 45)))
ax.set_xticklabels(["N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W", "NW"], fontsize=9, fontweight="bold")
ax.grid(color="lightgray", linewidth=0.6)
if beamwidth_deg > 0:
    # Light zone: every sky direction within half the beamwidth (great-circle
    # angle) of the satellite at some point in the pass, i.e. anywhere the
    # antenna can point and still hold the satellite inside its -3 dB beam.
    g_az, g_el = np.meshgrid(np.radians(np.linspace(0, 360, 361)), np.linspace(0, 90, 91))
    a1, z1 = np.radians(g_el)[..., None], g_az[..., None]
    a2, z2 = np.radians(track[:, 1]), np.radians(track[:, 0])
    cos_d = np.sin(a1) * np.sin(a2) + np.cos(a1) * np.cos(a2) * np.cos(z1 - z2)
    inside = (np.arccos(np.clip(cos_d, -1, 1)) <= np.radians(beamwidth_deg / 2)).any(axis=-1)
    ax.contourf(g_az, g_el, inside.astype(float), levels=[0.5, 1.5], colors=["#e4e4e4"], zorder=0)
ax.plot(np.radians(track[:, 0]), track[:, 1], color="#c0392b", linewidth=2)
fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.1, right=0.9, bottom=0.1, top=0.9)
fig.canvas.draw()
# Track in display pixels, so labels can be set perpendicular to the path
# (text running along the normal never collides with its neighbours).
disp = ax.transData.transform(np.column_stack([np.radians(track[:, 0]), track[:, 1]]))
center = ax.transData.transform((0, 90))
step = int(round(STEP_S / 5))
# One side of the track for every label: the side facing the zenith overall,
# so labels stay inside the circle, clear of the compass letters.
tg = np.gradient(disp, axis=0)
nn = np.column_stack([-tg[:, 1], tg[:, 0]]) / np.hypot(tg[:, 0], tg[:, 1])[:, None]
side = 1.0 if np.sum(np.einsum("ij,ij->i", nn, center - disp)) >= 0 else -1.0
for i, (t_row, el, az, _tx, _rx) in enumerate(rows):
    ax.plot(np.radians(az), el, "o", color="black", markersize=3)
    if i % 2:
        continue
    k = min(i * step, len(disp) - 1)
    tang = disp[min(k + 1, len(disp) - 1)] - disp[max(k - 1, 0)]
    nrm = side * np.array([-tang[1], tang[0]]) / np.hypot(*tang)
    ang = np.degrees(np.arctan2(nrm[1], nrm[0]))
    ha = "left"
    if nrm[0] < 0:  # keep text upright
        ang += 180
        ha = "right"
    off = 5 * nrm
    ax.annotate(f"{t_row.astimezone(tz):%H:%M:%S}", (np.radians(az), el), fontsize=6.5,
                rotation=ang, rotation_mode="anchor", ha=ha, va="center",
                xytext=(off[0], off[1]), textcoords="offset points")
for label, k in (("AOS", 0), ("LOS", len(track) - 1)):
    out = -side * nn[k] * 12  # outer side of the track, away from the time labels
    ax.annotate(label, (np.radians(track[k, 0]), track[k, 1]), fontsize=8, fontweight="bold",
                color="#c0392b", ha="center", va="center",
                xytext=(out[0], out[1]), textcoords="offset points")
if beamwidth_deg > 0:
    fig.text(0.5, 0.02, f"Gray: within ±{beamwidth_deg / 2:.0f}° of the satellite ({beamwidth_deg:.0f}° beamwidth)",
             ha="center", fontsize=7, color="gray")
sky_png = f".satskyplot_{rise:%Y%m%dT%H%M%S}.png"
fig.savefig(sky_png, dpi=200)
plt.close(fig)
```

#| label: ladder-table
#| output: asis

n = len(rows)
font_pt = 10 if n <= 14 else (9 if n <= 18 else 8)

lines = []
lines.append("```{=typst}")
lines.append("#grid(columns: (1fr, 8.4cm), gutter: 0.4cm, align: top,")
lines.append(f"[#set text(size: {font_pt}pt)")
lines.append("#table(")
lines.append("  columns: (1.25fr, 1.2fr, 1.2fr, 0.8fr, 0.7fr),")
lines.append("  stroke: 0.6pt + gray,")
lines.append("  inset: 3.5pt,")
lines.append('  fill: (x, y) => if y == 0 { rgb("#e0e0e0") } else { white },')
lines.append("  align: center + horizon,")
lines.append("  [*Time*], [*TX MHz*], [*RX MHz*], [*Az*], [*El*],")
for t, el, az, tx, rx in rows:
    lines.append(f"  [{t.astimezone(tz):%H:%M:%S}], [{tx:.3f}], [{rx:.3f}], [{az:.0f}°], [{el:.0f}°],")
lines.append(")],")
lines.append(f'[#image("{sky_png}", width: 100%)])')
lines.append("```")
print("\n".join(lines))

```{python}
#| output: asis
def esc(t):
    for ch in "\\#*_$@<`~":
        t = t.replace(ch, "\\" + ch)
    return t

def bullets(rows):
    return "\n".join(f"  - *{esc(l)}:* {esc(t)}" for l, t in rows)

notes = "\n".join(f"  - {esc(x)}" for x in info["notes"])
print("```{=typst}")
print("#set text(size: 8pt)")
print("#grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr), gutter: 0.5cm, align: top,")
print("[*Yaesu VX-6R + speaker mic: uplink TX*\n" + bullets(scs.tx_radio(info)) + "],")
print("[*Alinco DJ-VX50: downlink RX*\n" + bullets(scs.rx_radio(info)) + "],")
print(")")
print("#v(0.2cm)")
print("*Notes*\n" + notes)
print("")
print("*General*\n" + bullets(scs.GENERAL))
print("```")
```
